$comment: GATING FOR THE A-10b REFACTOR. Corrects my own incomplete site enumeration, separates two semantics that share one constant, and names a circularity the obvious refactor would introduce. Touches no artifact and no running job.

answers_referral.note: Arrives as a concrete bill rather than a hypothetical.

what_is_actually_there_measured.sites_I_MISSED: :1944 a plain loop over locales, benign; :1970 a DEFAULT PARAMETER VALUE; :3243 with its message at :3246

MY_ENUMERATION_WAS_INCOMPLETE.assessment: The coordinator is right. I generalised from a grep for the assertion pattern and missed the two sites that are not assertions. THAT IS THE SAME SHAPE AS EVERY SEARCH DEFECT IN THIS SPRINT'S CATALOGUE: a detector tuned to one form, reporting confidently on all forms.

RULING_1_ONE_CONSTANT_CARRIES_TWO_SEMANT.the_coordinator_finding_confirmed: :3243 reads 'if len(verdicts) != FROZEN_PROMPT_SET_CONCEPT_COUNT' and raises 'refusing to write a partial grid.json'. THAT IS A FAIL-CLOSED OUTPUT GUARD, NOT AN IDENTITY CHECK. The :779-797 block asks IS THIS THE PROMPT SET I EXPECT. :3243 asks DID I FINISH.
RULING_1_ONE_CONSTANT_CARRIES_TWO_SEMANT.why_it_matters_operationally: That guard is what protects the standing instruction that a PARTIAL GRID IS EVIDENCE TO BE ADJUDICATED, NEVER OVERWRITTEN. Weakening it does not produce a wrong number; it produces a silently truncated run that looks complete.
RULING_1_ONE_CONSTANT_CARRIES_TWO_SEMANT.VERDICT: IDENTITY and COMPLETENESS resolve from the same source but are DIFFERENT CHECKS with different failure meanings, and must be written as such. A mechanical swap of all sites to one lookup is PROHIBITED.

failure_semantics_that_must_stay_distinc.identity_failure: WRONG ARTIFACT. The run has loaded a prompt set that is not the one it was configured for. Abort before any compute.
failure_semantics_that_must_stay_distinc.completeness_failure: INCOMPLETE RUN. The right artifact was loaded and the work did not finish. Abort before any WRITE, preserving what exists as evidence.
failure_semantics_that_must_stay_distinc.why_conflating_them_is_dangerous: They abort at different points for different reasons. A completeness failure reported as an identity failure sends an operator to check the prompt set, which is fine, and leaves them with no reason to preserve a partial grid, which is not.

RULING_2_THE_CIRCULARITY_THE_OBVIOUS_REF.THE_HAZARD_NEITHER_OF_US_HAD_STATED: IF THE EXPECTED COUNT IS RESOLVED FROM THE ARTIFACT'S OWN metadata.json, THEN :781 VALIDATES THE METADATA AGAINST ITSELF.
RULING_2_THE_CIRCULARITY_THE_OBVIOUS_REF.the_chain: metadata declares concept_count = N. The identity check compares metadata.concept_count against the per-version expectation. If that expectation is read from the same metadata, the comparison is N == N and passes for every N. THE IDENTITY CHECK BECOMES A TAUTOLOGY.
RULING_2_THE_CIRCULARITY_THE_OBVIOUS_REF.and_then_the_completeness_check_inherits: With identity trivially satisfied, :3243 compares verdicts against a number the artifact asserted about itself and nobody verified. A v2 set that mis-declared its own count would satisfy both checks.
RULING_2_THE_CIRCULARITY_THE_OBVIOUS_REF.REQUIRED: The per-version expectation resolves from a PINNED VERSION REGISTRY -- an external mapping of prompt-set version to (row_count, concept_count, locales, sha256) -- NEVER from the artifact under validation.
RULING_2_THE_CIRCULARITY_THE_OBVIOUS_REF.why_this_is_the_whole_point_of_the_curre: The hardcoded 14 is ugly and it is EXTERNAL, which is what makes :781 a real check. Any refactor that loses externality trades an ugly correct check for a tidy vacuous one. That trade is prohibited.

RULING_3_THE_DEFAULT_PARAMETER_AT_1970.confirmed: :1970 is 'locales: tuple[str, ...] = FROZEN_PROMPT_SET_LOCALES' -- a DEFAULT VALUE, not an assertion.
RULING_3_THE_DEFAULT_PARAMETER_AT_1970.the_blast_radius: Changing a default changes behaviour at EVERY call site that omits the argument, silently, without any of those call sites appearing in a grep for the assertion pattern. The coordinator is right that this is the standard silent-blast-radius shape.
RULING_3_THE_DEFAULT_PARAMETER_AT_1970.REQUIRED: Do not repoint the default. Make locales EXPLICIT at every call site, then remove the default. An explicit argument is greppable and a default is not.
RULING_3_THE_DEFAULT_PARAMETER_AT_1970.1944_is_benign: Confirmed. A plain loop over locales; it follows whatever the constant resolves to and carries no independent semantics.

A_10b_SIZED.smaller_than_the_coordinator_costed: Because extending v1 was prohibited from the start; v1 and job 413287 are untouched.
A_10b_SIZED.larger_than_I_enumerated: Nineteen occurrences across three constants, not three.
A_10b_SIZED.AND_THE_DIFFERENCE_IS_NOT_SIZE: It is that the sites are not all the same kind of check. A refactor sized by counting occurrences and executed by search-and-replace would pass review, pass tests that only exercise the identity path, and silently weaken the guard that protects partial-run evidence.
A_10b_SIZED.recommended_order: 1. Build the external version registry. 2. Repoint the IDENTITY checks to it and prove they still fail on a mismatched artifact, with a negative control. 3. Repoint the COMPLETENESS guard separately, with its own test that a short verdict list still raises. 4. Make locales explicit at call sites and remove the default LAST.

THE_THIRD_OPTION_IS_A_CORRECT_READING_OF.their_formulation: Because pi_gated binds PUBLIC USE and not the work, the persona science can be authored, discovered, gated and judged in v2 WITHOUT ANY PI SIGNATURE, provided nothing persona-related reaches a demo surface this sprint. Option A with the STAGE deferred rather than the WORK deferred.
THE_THIRD_OPTION_IS_A_CORRECT_READING_OF.verdict: CORRECT, AND IT FOLLOWS DIRECTLY FROM c14_gate_signatory_and_selection_objective RULING_1. I confirm the reading.
THE_THIRD_OPTION_IS_A_CORRECT_READING_OF.what_it_buys: It removes the PI gate from this sprint's critical path entirely while still producing the feature groups the researcher asked for.
THE_THIRD_OPTION_IS_A_CORRECT_READING_OF.the_condition_that_makes_it_true: NOTHING persona-related reaches a demo, a public label, an export or an external artifact. The moment it does, the PI gate is live again and unsatisfied.
THE_THIRD_OPTION_IS_A_CORRECT_READING_OF.still_the_researchers_choice: The coordinator presented it as a consequence rather than a recommendation, which is the right handling. I am confirming it is available, not selecting it.

hard_stops: Refactoring all sites of the frozen constants through a single mechanism.
Resolving the expected count, row count or locales from the artifact under validation.
Repointing the :1970 default rather than making call sites explicit.
Landing the refactor without a negative control proving identity checks still fail on a mismatched artifact and the completeness guard still raises on a short verdict list.
Treating the third option as licence for any persona-related public surface.
